settings.b1_body:
We didn't start The Smooth Company to just make good hair days happen, we started it to help every day run that little bit smoother. So becoming a Certified B Corporation isn't a badge we're bolting on, it's proof of something we've believed since the beginning.

Certified B Corporation status means we've been independently assessed on how we treat our people, our planet, and our customers, and we came through it.

People over profit. Care over convenience. Better, even when better takes longer.
settings.b2_body: Getting here wasn't quick, and it wasn't meant to be. We opened up every part of our business to independent assessment, from how we source and manufacture, to how we treat our team, to how we show up for our customers. B Corp Certification isn't handed out. It's earned, one honest answer at a time.

settings.n1_body: This isn't a finish line, it's a checkpoint. Certification is reviewed every three years, and we're not planning to stand still in between. Every collection, every formula, every decision from here is another chance to raise the bar a little higher.
settings.n2_body: None of this happens without you. Every product you've picked up, every friend you've recommended us to, you've been part of building a business that does things properly. This certification is as much yours as it is ours.

settings.d_body:
We didn't start The Smooth Company to just make good hair days happen, we started it to help every day run that little bit smoother. So becoming a Certified B Corporation isn't a badge we're bolting on, it's proof of something we've believed since the beginning: that a smooth day for you shouldn't come at a cost to anyone else's. Long before there was a business plan, there was a promise from Áine: make it work, make it good, and make it right for the planet too.

Certified B Corporation status means we've been independently assessed on how we treat our people, our planet, and our customers, and we came through it. Not by scraping by, but because doing things properly has never been optional for us.

People over profit. Care over convenience. Better, even when better takes longer.

Getting here wasn't quick, and it wasn't meant to be. We opened up every part of our business to independent assessment, from how we source and manufacture, to how we treat our team, to how we show up for our customers. B Corp Certification isn't handed out. It's earned, one honest answer at a time.
settings.d_sub_body: We're now part of a network of 10,000+ Certified B Corps globally, and 110 businesses across Ireland, using business as a force for good.
